_doc: Worked example for the third storage shape: one JSON document holding an array of records — the shape a VS Code extension tends to write when it keeps a whole conversation history in a single file. `records` is the dotted path to that array; everything after it works exactly as it does for JSONL. Not enabled against any real path on purpose. Because a document like this is parsed whole, there is no byte offset to resume from: progress is the count of priced records already emitted, so the file may grow but must not reorder.
